text:
ana: Heads-up: SI workshop for NA partners with Nebula HW + AWS marketplace listing — need final playbook + certification exam outline. Who can own the deck and lab ops?

mike: I can take the deck. What do we need for HW shipping checklist?

jess: I propose gating cert eligibility on completing the labs + a 30-min viva. Can we reuse prod-sandbox for the hands-on?

tom: Sandbox needs an updated AMI and model bundles. @leo can you confirm access tokens for the SI orgs?

leo: Yep — I'll provision 5 orgs in prod-sandbox (us-west-2) and rotate tokens nightly. ETA tomorrow EOD.

partners-bot: Reminder: Marketplace listing draft due in 3 days — @ana please attach listing assets.

ana: (note: corrected name) Sorry typo — ana: Added initial checklist to the drive: https://drive.re/redwood/si-workshop — items: lab kit contents, test prompts, eval script, scoring rubric.

mike: For HW shipping include: power adapter, NVMe drive, preloaded USB with OS image, quickstart card. Ship manifest filename pattern: `SI_SHIP_{partner}_{date}.csv`.

jess: Draft training flow: 1) prework (2h) 2) day0 setup (1h) 3) hands-on labs (4h) 4) cert (30m viva + 20m practical). Need sample prompts + expected outputs for grading.

tom: We should automate practical grading. Proposed hook: 
```bash
python grade_lab.py --submission $ID --rubric rubric.json
```

ana: :thumbsup: Can we record sessions for partners who miss them? Legal clearance needed.

leo: Checked with Legal — recordings are OK if partner signs NDA. I'll add an NDA checkbox to the registration form and set required=true.

mike: HW constraint: how many kits do we have availability for this quarter?

jess: Recommend cohort size max 8 SI teams. If demand >8, run parallel cohorts or remote-only overflow.

ana: Action items summary:
- mike: deck + shipping template (due 2001234999)
- leo: sandbox orgs + NDA form (ETA tomorrow EOD)
- tom: grading hook + test images
- jess: cert rubric + sample prompts

partners-bot: Event created: "SI Enablement — HW + Marketplace" scheduled for 2001235600. RSVP required.

ana: Thanks all. Quick sync tomorrow 09:30 PT in partnerships huddle. If you can't make it, drop updates here.

mike: I’ll post the first draft of slides by EOD.

jess: I’ll draft the exam rubric and share in the drive.

tom: Will push grading script to infra repo and add CI check.

leo: Provisioning started — will ping when tokens live.
